items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and continue only bounded evidence work. Woot’s public terms do not establish rights to collect, derive, store, display, or alert on deal data; legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain blocked. Unknown: whether Woot would grant written permission. Smallest next step: owner chooses one option—(A) keep private while Legal prepares a draft permission request (recommended), or (B) authorize sending the request to Woot. I am not requeuing rc-9.com performance work because its existing repair item is open and the action mandate prohibits duplicate work before root-cause validation.

Recommendation: defer the CRO repository prototypes this cycle. MarkItDown, shadcn/ui, and Mermaid have plausible use cases, but current execution backlog is materially constrained: 140 approved proposals lack execution requests, 20 implementation requests failed, and zero outcomes are proven. Revisit after measurement and failure-repair queues drain; no production adoption is authorized.
